title: Daniloff, Viacheslav Viacheslavovich

page_data.en:

Daniloff V.V.-antecedents of:
421
Daniloff Viacheslav Viacheslavovich was born at Troitsk,
Received education in Khabarovsk Military College at
Vladivostok. Arrived at Harbin in 1922 and from there
left for Tientsin where was employed by Brener Bros &
Co.
In 1925 arrived at Shanghai where he graduated from "E
"Knige Phisical Culture Academy" and after that became em-
ployed by the academy in capacity of phisical instructor,
for 3 years. After that he worked as a musician(drummer)
In 1931 worked in Nagasaki, Japan, as a musician,
in 1935 in Manilla and in 1935 in Hankow, Honkong in 1927 in
Hankow, Chefoo and Tsingtao :
Served in S.V.C.S. transport in 1937 and was awarded
a medal for "Services rendered to community". After that
till 1942 worked as a musician, when entered service of R.E.A
A.D.S.C.M.P. where he is employed at present.
He is single and his father V.M.Danileff is employed
at railway police in Tsingtao as a passport controller.
His mother E.M.Danilioff, resides at Shanghai at 684
Av. Joffre. His sisters Tamara, Ludmila, Valentina and Ru-
fina are ballet dancers at present in Philipines.
He is known as an ardent white Russian.

达尼洛夫 V.V. - 履历：
421
达尼洛夫·维亚切斯拉夫·维亚切斯拉沃维奇（Daniloff Viacheslav Viacheslavovich）出生于特罗伊茨克（Troitsk），
在符拉迪沃斯托克的哈巴罗夫斯克军事学院（Khabarovsk Military College）接受教育。1922年抵达哈尔滨，随后从那里
前往天津，受雇于布伦纳兄弟公司（Brener Bros & Co.）。
1925年抵达上海，毕业于“E”
“Knige 体育学院”（Knige Phisical Culture Academy），此后在该学院
担任体育教员，为期3年。之后他从事乐师（鼓手）工作。
1931年在日本长崎担任乐师，
1935年在马尼拉，1935年在汉口，1927年在香港、
汉口、芝罘和青岛：
1937年在上海万国商团（S.V.C.S.）运输队服役，并因“为社区提供服务”而获颁勋章。此后
直至1942年一直从事乐师工作，随后进入俄罗斯东亚事务局（R.E.A.）
A.D.S.C.M.P.任职，目前仍在此供职。
他未婚，其父 V.M.达尼列夫（V.M.Danileff）在青岛铁路警察部门担任护照查验员。
其母 E.M.达尼利奥夫（E.M.Danilioff）居住在上海霞飞路684号。他的姐妹塔玛拉（Tamara）、柳德米拉（Ludmila）、瓦伦蒂娜（Valentina）和鲁菲娜（Ru-
fina）目前在菲律宾担任芭蕾舞演员。
他以狂热的白俄分子著称。
